facts.value: Incoming staff wishing to participate in Erasmus+ Staff Teaching or Training activities must be individually accepted by a staff member in the host department who is responsible for organising the teaching and/or training activities.
facts.programme_association: Work and Organisational Psychology / Work and Organisational Behaviour - MSc

facts.value: Acceptance is dependent on all parties in advance: The participant, the sending institution, the host department at the University of Limerick.
facts.programme_association: Work and Organisational Psychology / Work and Organisational Behaviour - MSc

facts.value: Agreement for hosting staff members is dependent on: Agreeing in advance to the contents of the teaching/training plan, the timing of the mobility, the presence of a signed Erasmus+ inter-institutional agreement (mandatory requirement for Staff Mobility for Teaching).
facts.programme_association: Work and Organisational Psychology / Work and Organisational Behaviour - MSc

facts.value: Potential visiting staff members will need to contact the relevant department in the first instance, with contact details to be found at https://www.ul.ie/.
facts.programme_association: Work and Organisational Psychology / Work and Organisational Behaviour - MSc
